**How to submit:** Write your answers in a document or on paper. Upload the file or a clear photo to the university e-learning platform. Due: **before lecture 19**.

A small studio wants to publish *Bubble Pop Kingdom* on the App Store.

- Name: "Bubble Pop Kingdom: The Greatest Bubble Adventure Ever" (54 characters)
- Icon: 512 × 512 pixels
- Screenshots: pictures from the trailer, made with a 3D style; the game is 2D
- A "Magic Box" costs 1 USD and gives random boosters; no odds are shown
- The game asks for the player's contacts "to invite friends"; there is no privacy policy

## Task 1 · The listing (2 marks)

a) Which two parts of the listing break the limits of the App Store? Write
the limit for each. (1 mark)

{{< answer-space lines=3 >}}

b) Which part of the listing is misleading, and how should the studio fix
it? (1 mark)

{{< answer-space lines=2 >}}

## Task 2 · The guidelines (3 marks)

For the "Magic Box" and for the contacts, write:

a) the part of the guidelines (Safety, Performance, Business, Design or
Legal); (1 mark)

b) what the rule asks for; (1 mark)

c) one fix for each problem. (1 mark)
